title: REST Gateways
summary: HTTP interfaces that expose Norito-first APIs for developers who prefer REST semantics over gRPC. These gateways provide deterministic transaction builders, ISO 20022 helpers, and offline flow support, with receipts and proofs aligned to protocol primitives for web and mobile SDK integration.
